## Featured projects

### Ask Clair's AI — the chat on this website (2026-10)
Code and architecture: https://github.com/YeChen-coder/clair-personal-site/tree/main/aws
- Triage agent hosted on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime: Claude Haiku 4.5 tool use routes each visitor message to RAG over Clair's GitHub docs (Bedrock Knowledge Base, vectors in Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 + pgvector, which scales to zero when idle), a message ticket (DynamoDB + SNS email), a photo tool, or a job-fit analysis.
- Job-fit analysis is a multi-agent workflow: extract the requirements from a pasted job description, research each in parallel, grade the evidence, write a report, and have a verifier check it against the evidence before anything reaches the visitor.
- Tools are exposed as MCP tools through AgentCore Gateway; everything is CloudFormation; traced end to end with OpenTelemetry.
- Cost and safety built in from the start: per-IP rate limits, daily caps, IAM-only endpoints and an automatic budget cut-off.
- Chose the embedding model by measurement: Amazon Titan Text Embeddings V2 against Cohere Embed v4 on 40 bilingual visitor questions over 1,560 chunks (hit@3 88% vs 82%, within noise), so the knowledge base kept the cheaper Titan.

### EBOBotToDigitalPet and EBOBotQwenRealtime — a home robot that talks (2026-09, 2026-10)
https://github.com/YeChen-coder/EBOBotToDigitalPet · https://github.com/YeChen-coder/EBOBotQwenRealtime
- Turned an Enabot EBO home robot into a robot that sees, listens and holds a conversation: translated the vendor's private cloud protocol into plain RTSP and HTTP, then wired it into Home Assistant and OpenAI Realtime.
- Runs on Docker at home or on AWS Fargate (infrastructure in CloudFormation), with a handover that guarantees only one side ever drives the robot.
- A diagnostic agent checks health, applies only the recoveries it is allowed to, and escalates the rest to a two-tier Codex analysis that sees filtered logs and read-only code, never cloud credentials.
- Third generation moved the voice from OpenAI Realtime to Qwen Omni Realtime to run entirely at home. Qwen has no built-in noise reduction, so TV and phone audio that OpenAI had filtered out began triggering false wake-ups; fixed with a gate before any conversation starts: local Whisper transcribes the speech and a small model judges whether it was addressed to the robot.
- Also in v3: two-layer memory (household facts and short-lived news), and the robot drives over to greet people and returns to charge on its own.

### SpecterSaysHi — realtime voice companion with a self-trained avatar (2026-10)
https://github.com/YeChen-coder/SpecterSaysHi
- Voice companion that speaks first when a camera or wristband notices Clair is home, looks things up mid-conversation, and keeps two-layer memory between chats.
- The face is a lip-sync model (FeatherTalk, PyTorch) Clair trained on a local RTX 4070 SUPER, not a paid avatar API; about 64 ms from the first complete 100 ms audio packet to a frame drawn on screen (median of six runs, measured locally).
- The same framework drives two sibling projects: GPTSaysHi (ChatGPT voice on Windows) and JesusSaysHi.

### JesusSaysHi — realtime voice character grounded in a fixed text (2026-10)
https://github.com/YeChen-coder/JesusSaysHi
- The four Gospels (about 3,800 verses) do not fit in a prompt, and from memory the model quoted another translation, so scripture reaches the character only through retrieval: RAGFlow with structure-aware chunks, hybrid search and Voyage reranking, plus a relevance threshold enforced in code; below it, nothing is recalled.
- Ingestion enrichment: users speak modern English while the text is scripture ("burned out" never appears in it), so at ingestion an LLM wrote 5 keywords and 3 likely questions in modern phrasing for each of about 4,300 verse chunks. With parent-child chunking (match a verse, hand the model its whole section) and query rewriting, hybrid search then beat dense-only retrieval (91-93% vs 87% hit@3 in an ablation).
- Redesigned after evaluation: an earlier design that could only say what was retrieved scored well on retrieval (95% hit@3 on 55 hand-labelled questions, with an ablation study) but sounded like someone looking verses up, not a person. The current design treats the Gospels as his own memory: whole episodes of his life are retrieved and told in his own words.
- Two-phase reply in one realtime session: a first prompt has him say one short sentence that receives what the user said while retrieval runs in the background, then a second prompt continues with the retrieved memory. Same session, so the context stays continuous; median 1.9 s from the end of speech to his first sound.
- A small model classifies every turn (information, needs a professional, conversation), and the label is enforced in code because a prompt rule alone did not hold. Every reply is checked for faithfulness to the retrieved episode and for verbatim scripture; the full realtime model was chosen over mini after measuring detail errors (18 of 30 tellings vs 4 of 23).
- A crisis check runs as a guardrail outside the model.

## Other projects

- [tianjin-chem-bank](https://github.com/YeChen-coder/tianjin-chem-bank): document AI that splits Word exam papers into a bank of 10,000+ questions, keeps formulas as LaTeX and exports native Word equations; AI-generated variants pass structure checks and a separate review. GLM, LaTeX, OOXML, SQLite.
- [PhoneCallAgent](https://github.com/YeChen-coder/PhoneCallAgent): a learning demo, not a deployed product. AI phone receptionist for a fictional clinic with scheduling tools, tests and simulated calls. Twilio, OpenAI Realtime.
- [ResumeBuilder](https://github.com/YeChen-coder/ResumeBuilder): local-first resume workspace with reusable bullets and Word/PDF export; AI output arrives as validated JSON. TypeScript, React, Drizzle.
- [colorful-bionic-extension](https://github.com/YeChen-coder/colorful-bionic-extension): reading extension for ADHD readers, published on the Microsoft Edge Add-ons store.
- [Attention brakes](https://github.com/YeChen-coder/Windows-app-restriction): limits chosen apps on Windows (Python, Win32) and websites in Edge (published extension).
- [Bluetooth gadgets, reverse-engineered ×3](https://github.com/YeChen-coder/foci-reverse): moved three app-only BLE devices (FOCI, Pavlok 3, Bobo Bei Pro) onto a computer. Python, bleak.
- [PTE practice tools ×3](https://github.com/YeChen-coder/PTE-Speaking-exercise): speaking, dictation and email-writing practice. Azure Speech, Flask.
- [SmartErgonomicLearningStation](https://github.com/YeChen-coder/SmartErgonomicLearningStation): four-person McMaster course project, a sit-stand desk that tracks presence and sitting time. Raspberry Pi, PubNub, S3.
- [RCCarRelated](https://github.com/YeChen-coder/RCCarRelated): lane-keeping RC car with computer vision and a PID controller.
- [AniMatch](https://github.com/YeChen-coder/AniMatch): party game scoring how well a photo copies an anime expression. AWS Lambda, ECR, MediaPipe.
